rules.description: Child must be at least 9 months old
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be at least 9 months old to qualify for the universal 15 hours free childcare

rules.description: Child must be under 5 years old and not yet in reception class
rules.reason_if_failed: The universal 15 hours free childcare is for children aged 9 months up to when they start reception class

rules.description: Child must be a UK resident
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be a UK resident to qualify for free childcare

rules.description: Applicant must have parental responsibility for the child
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have parental responsibility for the child to apply for their free childcare

rules.description: Child must not yet be in reception class
rules.reason_if_failed: Children in reception class receive free early years education through school

edge_cases.description: Child has special educational needs or disabilities
edge_cases.action: Route to SEN team. Child may be eligible for additional support hours and specialist provision.
Additional documentation required. Adoption certificate needed instead of birth certificate.

edge_cases.description: Child is looked after by local authority (foster care)
edge_cases.action: Contact local authority. Different funding arrangements apply for looked after children.

edge_cases.description: Parent or child is non-UK national
edge_cases.action: Additional right to reside checks required. May need Home Office verification.
